transcript: I always thought I was in good shape but doing the exercises here and learning how to actually use your muscles and breathe it's made me ten times better athlete. It's just been a great community I mean we come in dojo everyone's in a gi, everyone's a student and you know everything that's outside dojos outside a dojo makes for a great escape. I'm stronger I'm much stronger than I used to be two months ago physically and mentally I feel more focused and fantastic. I find that I've used the Potomac Kenpo not only to get fit but to meet people in the area and as an active form of meditation I just find that being able to replicate forms and Kenpos and you know special sequences of movement that require your focus and your attention. I was happy, I wasn't stressed I enjoyed myself, I enjoyed my life. It's awesome it really did change my life in a lot of ways.
